children: Overview
Germany diagnostics systems provider to sell loss-making Diatron MI business for €10 mln plus earn-outs
Company to book €44.1 mln impairment in Q3 and €4-9 mln deconsolidation loss in Q4
Nine-month 2026 prelim sales €164.9 mln, prelim adjusted EBIT margin 8.3%, both including divested unit
Outlook
STRATEC expects 2026 sales to be stable to slightly higher than €223.5 mln on constant-currency basis
Company forecasts 2026 adjusted EBIT margin of 13.0%-15.0% after divestment, up from prior 10.0%
STRATEC says previous medium-term targets are withdrawn and will be updated with 2026 annual report
Result Drivers
DIVESTMENT OF LOSS-MAKING UNIT - Co said sale of Diatron MI, which generated negative EBIT, will remove loss-making operations from group results
